days.title: Rivers and Long Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Weser river valley
stops.detail: As part of the Weser Uplands, this walking region offers the best of both worlds: bordered by the romantic Weser river valley and dotted with picturesque towns and villages, it rises into a dramatic low mountain landscape with rugged cliffs and sweeping views.

stops.name: Weser Uplands Route (Weserbergland-Weg)
stops.detail: Two long-distance routes, the Weser Uplands Route (Weserbergland-Weg) and the Ith-Hils-Weg , complete the walking experience, ensuring there’s something for everyone.
